findings.oracle: Drives real production _is_b580_device(name,id) with name 'Generic GPU' (no 'b580' substring) so the verdict depends solely on the device-ID path. Positive oracle = the four independently-documented Intel Arc B580 PCI device-ID spellings of 0xE20B; negative oracle = real adjacent/foreign IDs (Battlemage 0xE20C, NVIDIA RTX 4090 0x2684, AMD RX6700XT 0x73DF, empty/garbage/'e20'). Asserts each B580 alias returns True and every non-B580 id returns False, making the test go RED if the matcher regressed to substring/any-id matching or wrong constant membership.
